title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 2.46
exact_target: If an entire-function family takes at most a specified number of different values at each point, must the family itself have at most that cardinality?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2302046 (AMR-022-2046). CC BY 4.0.
